title: 第1章 富可敌国的富婆第2章 扛上山当压寨夫人
content_zh:
黑风山，秋风萧瑟。
几片枯黄的落叶打着旋儿落下，刚好盖在了一块青黑色的巨石上。
巨石上，躺着一个皮肤黝黑的少年郎。
约莫十五六岁，一身洗得发白的粗布麻衣，嘴里叼着根狗尾巴草，正百无聊的对着天空发呆。
他叫纯小白。
是这黑风寨八百里地界上，令人闻风丧胆的唯一山大王。
“大王，大王快看，大肥羊来了！”
枯草丛中，独眼龙二当家从官道上，收回他那只独眼，压低嗓子打破了这份萧瑟。
“足足三辆大车！”
纯小白侧过身，抬起眼皮。
前方溪边，一支插着镖旗的车队，在一队人马的护送下，叮叮哐哐朝着他们脚下晃悠悠而来。
“你长只眼睛是用来喘气的？能不能专业点？”
纯小白只看了一眼，便收回目光，嘴里的狗尾巴草随着说话晃悠道。
“看那车辙印，入土两寸，如此沉重，要么拉的是整车的金砖，要么......就是一车破铜烂铁。”
“再看那护卫，一个个脚步虚浮，两眼发直，哈欠连天。”
“你们告诉本大王，若是真金白银，东家会请这么一群软脚虾来押镖？”
纯小白顿了顿声，再次强调道。
“本大王说过，咱们黑风寨现在只做高端局，抢软银，这样才方便本大王去修仙携带！”
一众山贼半信半疑间，车队已经行到近前。
一阵秋风卷过，掀翻了头车的遮雨布。

帘子下，没有金银珠宝，没有绫罗绸缎，只有一块灰扑扑、冷冰冰的长条青石碑，上面还隐约刻着字迹。
“……”
山贼们瞬间鸦雀无声。
“这他娘的……竟然是三车墓碑？”
“真是晦气！咱们山匪可不兴抢这玩意儿啊！”
随后，一双双目光齐刷刷回转，崇拜的看向那块青黑巨石上、再次懒洋洋躺下的少年郎。
“大王果然专业！”
“行了！别拍马屁，赶紧给本大王盯好了！”
纯小白吼上一句，嘴角的狗尾巴草换到右边，枕着冰凉的石头，再次看向天空。
他老爹是黑风寨瓢把子，一次带着兄弟们出去“搞外快”，点儿背，碰上了硬茬，给自己给交代了。
临死前，老爹将山大王的位置传给了他，并留下了遗言。
攒钱！
等朝廷气数尽了，就扯杆子起义，将大梁的龙椅给抢过来，将来三宫六院，给纯家的血脉发扬光大！
子承父业，他六岁就成了山大王。
content_en:
Heifeng Mountain, the autumn wind is bleak.
A few withered yellow leaves swirled down and just covered a blue-black boulder.
Lying on the boulder was a dark-skinned young man.
He was about fifteen or sixteen years old, dressed in coarse linen clothes that had been washed white, with a piece of dogtail grass in his mouth, staring at the sky in a daze out of boredom.
His name is Chun Xiaobai.
He is the only mountain king who is feared in the eight hundred miles of Heifeng Village.
"Your Majesty, your Majesty, look, the big fat sheep is here!"
Among the withered grass, the one-eyed Long Er took back his one eye from the official road and lowered his voice to break the desolation.
"Three big cars!"
Chun Xiaobai turned sideways and raised his eyelids.
Ahead of the stream, a motorcade with escort flags, escorted by a group of people and horses, swayed towards their feet.
"Do you have an eye for breathing? Can you be more professional?"
Chun Xiaobai only glanced at it, then withdrew his gaze, and the dog's tail grass in his mouth swayed as he spoke.
"Look at the rut marks, which are two inches deep into the soil. It's so heavy. It's either a truckload of gold bricks or... it's just a truckload of scrap metal."
"Looking at the guards again, their steps were frivolous, their eyes were straight, and they were yawning."
"Tell me, my king, if it were real money, my boss would hire such a group of soft-footed shrimps to guard the bodyguards?"
Chun Xiaobai paused and emphasized again.
"I have said that our Heifeng Village is now only doing high-end games and grabbing SoftBank. This will make it easier for me to carry it with me when I am cultivating immortals!"
The group of bandits were half convinced, and the convoy was already approaching.
A gust of autumn wind blew past and overturned the rain cover of the leading car.
Under the curtain, there was no gold, silver, jewelry, or silk, only a gray, cold long bluestone tablet with vague writings engraved on it.
"..."
The bandits fell silent for a moment.
"This damn thing...is actually three cars of tombstones?"
"What bad luck! We bandits are not in the mood to steal this thing!"
Then, both pairs of eyes turned around and looked admiringly at the young man lying lazily on the blue and black boulder again.
"Your Majesty is really professional!"
"Okay! Stop flattering me and keep an eye on me now!"
Chun Xiaobai yelled, moved the dog's tail grass at the corner of his mouth to the right, rested his head on the cold stone, and looked at the sky again.
His father was the boss of Heifeng Village. He once took his brothers out to "make extra money", but he was a bit arrogant and ran into some trouble, so he had to answer for himself.
Before he died, his father passed on the position of Mountain King to him and left his last words.
Save money!
When the power of the imperial court is exhausted, they will rebel and seize the dragon chair from Daliang. In the future, the three palaces and six courtyards will carry forward the blood of the Chun family!
The son inherited his father's legacy and became the king of the mountain at the age of six.
